top5.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX’s one-million-unit AI satellite network
top5.description: The FCC approved Starmind, SpaceX’s project to launch up to one million solar-powered satellites equipped with AI data centers. Despite opposition from Amazon, Viasat, and astronomers, the first launches are planned for 2027 and the network must be completed by 2040.
top5.why: The FCC’s approval of SpaceX’s planned one-million-satellite AI network could reshape space infrastructure, cloud computing, spectrum competition and astronomical regulation.

top5.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below Their IPO Price
top5.description: Anthropic shares fell below their IPO price less than a week after going public, suggesting investors still doubt that revenue will exceed costs.
top5.why: Anthropic shares falling below their IPO price is an important market test of whether frontier-AI revenues can justify enormous computing and operating costs.

top5.title: HPE shares fall as AI-related margin decline weighs
top5.description: HPE shares fell about 16%, as margin guidance overshadowed an improved forecast for 2027 revenue growth. Demand for AI servers is supporting revenue, but component costs are rising faster than selling prices.
top5.why: HPE’s sharp share-price decline shows that surging AI-server demand may not translate into profits when component costs rise faster than vendors’ pricing power.

top5.title: Chinese labs estimate they are up to nine months behind the United States
top5.description: Chip restrictions, limited access to Nvidia hardware and anti-distillation measures are weighing on DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba. DeepSeek researchers reportedly estimate internally that they are no more than nine months behind.
top5.why: Chinese AI labs reportedly being within nine months of U.S. leaders despite chip restrictions highlights the limits of export controls and the intensity of strategic competition.

top5.title: OpenAI tests private inference for businesses
top5.description: OpenAI’s Private Inference runs a company’s queries on its best models without OpenAI being able to see the data. The service is being tested with early business customers.
top5.why: OpenAI’s private-inference trials could remove a major data-confidentiality barrier to enterprise adoption of frontier AI models.
